statement.p: Find the following for the function y=5\sin \left(4x+9\right)
(a) What is the period of y=5\sin \left(4x+9\right)\text{?}
(b) What is the amplitude of y=5\sin \left(4x+9\right)\text{?}
(c) What is the phase shift of y=5\sin \left(4x+9\right)\text{?} (Use a positive number for a shift to the right, and negative for to the left.)
